Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Test type: Detailed cancer-related history and physical examination
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Every 3 to 6 months for the first 3 years, every 6 to 12 months for the next 2 years, and annually thereafter
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: Regular follow-up care is essential to monitor for signs of disease recurrence and manage any long-term side effects of treatment.
Colonoscopy is recommended for cancer screening in the general population starting at age 50.
CT colonography is an alternative to colonoscopy for colorectal cancer screening.

Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Test type: Low-dose CT (LDCT) for lung cancer screening
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Annually for current or former smokers aged 55-74 with at least a 30 pack-year smoking history
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: Annual LDCT screening is recommended for high-risk individuals to detect lung cancer early.

Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Annually for postmenopausal women on selective estrogen receptor modulator therapies (SERMs)
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: Annual gynecologic assessments are recommended for postmenopausal women on SERMs due to the increased risk of endometrial cancer.
